headline: ECB’s Lagarde Sees Inflation Staying High, Signals No Rate Course Change
summary: European Central Bank President Christine Lagarde stated that inflation is expected to remain high and indicated little reason to alter the current monetary policy rate course.
why: The European Central Bank sets monetary policy for the eurozone, directly influencing borrowing costs and economic activity across the bloc.

impacts.name: Eurozone interest rates
impacts.why: Lagarde signaled that the ECB's current policy rate course will remain unchanged.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Comments from the ECB president regarding persistent inflation and steady rate expectations shape market pricing for future European borrowing costs.
